dct_description_sm: Salinity and temperature in sea ice influence the ice algal habitat. These parameters allow to calculate the percentage of brine salinity and volume in ice. Due to the importance of ice algae in the ice-covered Arctic, it is essential to characterized their environment and the impact of melt during the melting period. It becomes essential to monitor these physical data to complement those of biology and chemistry.
dct_title_s: Sea ice salinity and temperature at Qikiqtarjuak, Nunavut, 2016
